# Beth Aden AI

> Beth Aden is a strategic operations and AI systems partner. She helps business owners and leadership teams coordinate important projects, improve workflows, and use practical AI in everyday operations.

## Services

- [Strategic Operations Support](https://www.bethadenai.com/services#operations-support): Ongoing support with priorities, ownership, reporting, and follow-through.
- [Workflow & Systems Buildout](https://www.bethadenai.com/services#workflow-systems): Workflow mapping, handoffs, dashboards, and practical AI assistants or automation.
- [Launch, Bid & Transition Coordination](https://www.bethadenai.com/services#project-coordination): Workback planning, cross-team coordination, and readiness tracking for complex projects.
